instruction: Candid photographic medium close-up of two young women walking side-by-side outdoors. On the left, the blonde woman in a brown cap and black puffer vest (R2) smiles warmly, looking down. On the right, the red-haired woman wearing wire-rimmed glasses and a light blue knit vest (R1) smiles happily. The blonde woman (R2) has her right arm draped over the red-haired woman's (R1) shoulder in a friendly embrace. The background is softly blurred under gentle, natural daylight.
